title: Room Six Came With a Polite STRANGER 🛎️
description:
My dad and I got Room Six at a motel where the last guest's review card comes true. The pool is a bucket.

Our card said the man in the closet is very polite.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Who wrote the last card about us, the closet man or the motel?
